jobPlaceholder: Paste the full text of the job advert here…
englishOnly: The letter is written in English. The tool reads an English job advert and an English CV, and fills an English letter template from them.
needBoth: Add the job description and your CV to start.
privacy: Your CV is read in this tab. Nothing is stored.
titleFromPosting: The role comes from the posting.
titleFromCv: We could not find a job title in the posting, so this uses the title in your CV.
sourcesNote: Every skill is in both your CV and the posting, and every result is a line from your CV.
noResult: Your CV has no line with a number in it, so the letter marks where your result goes.

full.name: Full letter
full.hint: Four short paragraphs. Use it as an email body or attach it as a PDF.

short.name: Short letter
short.hint: For an email or a form with a small text box.

toastCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select the letter and copy it yourself.
noTitleHeading: We could not find a job title
noTitleBody: Neither document names a role we recognise. Paste the full advert, including the title at the top, then try again.
missingHeading: In the posting, not in your CV
missingNote: Your letter leaves these out because your CV never mentions them. An employer reads the letter and the CV together, so a gap in one shows in both.

ctaGaps.title: Close these gaps
ctaGaps.body: This posting asks for {count, plural, one {# term} other {# terms}} your CV never mentions. FitMyCV rewrites your CV and cover letter against it, using the experience you already have.
ctaGaps.label: Close these gaps

ctaCovered.title: Send a CV that matches the letter
ctaCovered.body: Your CV already covers this posting's terms. FitMyCV rewrites your CV against it so the strongest evidence sits at the top.
ctaCovered.label: Tailor my CV

exampleHeading: A simple job application letter example
